sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their strong league position, Sandbach come into this fixture on the back of a recent loss, though their overall form remains solid with wins and a draw preceding that defeat. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in poor form, making this a favorable matchup for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong sides—Bridgnorth bouncing back from consecutive defeats while Eccleshall are in excellent recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday and also feature in a midweek fixture at Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a battle between mid-table sides, both capable performers this season. Barnton travel to face Shawbury United, who are in alarming form having lost their last six matches and sit second-bottom. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between struggling mid-to-lower-table sides. Brereton Social, bottom-three, begin their week hosting Widnes Town at home on Saturday before that Wednesday midweek clash against Wolverhampton Casuals. Crewe play host to Allscott Heath on Saturday, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town—both sides occupying the lower reaches of the division.
